Inside Macintosh: Telephony /

Chapter 5 - Telephone Manager Messages

This chapter describes how to monitor and respond to telephony activities based on messages passed to your application by the Telephone Manager. It describes the functions you use to determine which messages a telephone tool supports and to register and deactivate the message handlers that process the messages for your application. This chapter also describes all of the terminal, directory number, and call appearance messages that the Telephone Manager can send to your application's message handlers.

For information about the messages that the Telephone Manager can send to a telephone tool and the messages that a telephone tool can send to the Telephone Manager, see the chapter "Telephone Tools."
